blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has issued Executive Order No. 129, increasing the Minimum Access Volume (MAV) for corn this year from 220,000 metric tons (MT) to 500,000 MT. Executive Secretary Ralph Recto signed the order by authority of Marcos on Oct. 26, Monday, and made it public on Tuesday. READ: Lower rice, corn harvests expected in Q3 According to the EO, the MAV Management Committee was directed to formulate and issue implementing guidelines within 30 days from the order’s effectivity.
